messages:
Aisha: Heads-up we pushed Kestrel-lite-ptq into canary. Latency good but structured toolcall parse fails spiked. infra-bot posted run: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/kestrel

Tom: Numbers? Any idea if it's suffix noise like earlier PTQ runs? :thinking:

Yuki (Eval): Canary summary: samples=920, parse_fail=3.4% vs fp16 baseline 0.13%. Majority labels = trailing-text, truncated-array, escaped-newlines in strings. Top templates affected: multi-step checklists and follow-up notes.

Aisha: Reproduced locally with streaming+kv-cache on, batch=10. Turning kv-cache off or increasing chunk_size to 64 reduces failures dramatically. Hypothesis: PTQ rounding changes tokenization at chunk boundaries leading to continuation tokens.

Tom: Short-term mitigation: implement an opt-in non-blocking json_rescue in the serving adapter that finds last balanced brace, strips garbage after it, normalizes escapes, then attempt parse. If rescue succeeds tag as rescued in telemetry. We keep strict linter for signal.

Yuki (Eval): I'm exporting top-200 failing prompts to eval harness (erun-59055X). Plan: run them across fp16, ptq-int8(per-tensor), ptq-int8(per-channel), and ptq-int8 with kv-cache disabled. Also add a streaming-slice test with 32-token frames to emulate chunked delivery.

infra-bot: Canary report: model=Kestrel-lite-ptq(int8), samples=920, parse_fail=3.4%, mean_rt=150ms

Tom: Action items: @Tom -> prototype json_rescue (opt-in) + ensure both original and repaired payloads logged. @Yuki -> run eval matrix and post failure histogram by EOD. @Aisha -> run quant-bisect (per-tensor vs per-channel, symmetric vs asymmetric) and repeat canary without kv-cache. Hold rollout until parse_fail <0.5% on matrix or rescue+telemetry accepted.

Aisha: Agreed. We'll keep strict validation in canary but mark rescued samples so we can triage fixes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
